description: The BenchBox report says update_item with an empty context on an item whose context is non-empty returns E_STATE 'operation produced no state change' and leaves the field. On todo-db 0.10.1 this does not reproduce: through the real todo-db-mcp stdio server, context="" and description="" both clear the field and are recorded as updates. store.op_update removes the key when given an empty string. What is missing is a test that proves it over the MCP path and for an update that changes nothing.
